settings.heading: Caring for Your Silver
settings.description: Every Silver Play piece is handcrafted in 925 sterling silver — 92.5% pure silver and 7.5% other metals for strength, stamped '925' on every piece. With a little care, it will last a lifetime.

settings.title: Store It Right
settings.body: Store in the anti-tarnish pouch provided — airtight storage that keeps the shine for years. Keep pieces separate so they don't scratch each other.

settings.title: Keep It Dry
settings.body: Avoid contact with perfume, lotions and water. Put your jewellery on last, after other products have dried, and take it off before you shower or swim.

settings.title: Clean It Gently
settings.body: Wipe gently with a soft cloth after wearing. For deeper cleaning, use a mild silver polishing cloth — the same one that ships in your box.

settings.title: BIS Hallmark Certificate
settings.body: A digital QR card verifying purity and provenance for every piece.

settings.title: Anti-Tarnish Pouch
settings.body: Airtight storage that keeps the shine for years.

settings.title: Silver Polishing Cloth
settings.body: For the gentle at-home clean between wears.

settings.title: Your Silver Play Piece
settings.body: Individually assayed and laser-hallmarked before it ships.
